items.stem: The most important early step in preparing a talk is to:

options.text: Define the single core message the audience should remember
options.rationale: Correct: a clear takeaway drives every other choice.
Design follows message, not the reverse.

options.text: Write the full script word for word
options.rationale: Scripting precedes the message risks losing focus.

items.stem: Which TWO practices improve slide effectiveness? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Limit each slide to one idea with minimal text
options.rationale: Correct: one idea per slide aids comprehension.

options.text: Use a visual or chart that makes the point faster than words
options.rationale: Correct: the right visual supports the message.

options.text: Fill the slide with the full speaker script
options.rationale: Dense text competes with the speaker.
That bores the audience and adds no value.
